outcome: Compliance rate for red blood cell (RBC) transfusion indication
cohort: The study included 171 women who were at least 6 hours postpartum and received at least one RBC transfusion during their delivery hospitalization between January 2005 and February 2022.
finding: The centre's compliance rate for RBC transfusion indication was 79.5% and met current practice guidelines, although maternal medical comorbidity and abnormal placentation predicted guideline non-compliance.
